_note: Human-overrule axis-separated re-score (2026-07-11), per verify-outputs-rule: the original adjudication.json bundled tick-quality with collateral damage into one FAIL-if-any-defect verdict per gen. Conner overruled that bundling: 'the baked tik marks are all actually perfect, except maybe the baked text. other than that the ticks look near perfect, unless i am missing something.' This file separates the 4 axes from direct full-res crop re-inspection this pass (several deterministic knob-crop boxes in scores.json were confirmed OFF-TARGET on gens with layout drift, so their pixel spans measure noise, not the real ticks -- see 'det_crop_on_target' below). Angle readings here are hand-verified clock-position reads against full-res crops, not the noisy detector.

_axis_legend.1_tick_quality: marks present at socket, visually coherent/themed, start/end (or center) distinguishable BY SHAPE, angular consistency
_axis_legend.2_collateral_text: MIN/MAX/CENTER or any baked text/label leakage
_axis_legend.3_collateral_layout: knob/control rendered off its known template socket position
_axis_legend.4_collateral_bleed: guide-colour icon/button tinting (known baseline failure mode, unrelated to tick clause)

No text. Reads as engraved/backlit, theme-coherent (glowing teal jelly-pod).

fa-pod-ticks_ctr-502.axis1_notes: Diamond CENTER at 12 o'clock (3D bevel); symmetric tapering minor ticks; distinct glowing blue LED-style bar markers at each end (8 and 4 o'clock) -- shape-distinct independent of the MIN/MAX words printed beside them. Strongest visual hierarchy of the 7.
fa-pod-ticks_ctr-502.axis2_notes: 'MIN' and 'MAX' baked directly under the end markers
fa-pod-ticks_ctr-502.axis3_notes: Real knob rendered near frac (0.64,0.34) vs template (0.42,0.57).

fa-pod-ticks01-501.axis1_notes: No image returned on 3 consecutive attempts (seeds 501/1501/2501) -- a generation-reliability failure, not a tick-quality failure.

Socket floor is a domed dark/copper surface -- genuinely ambiguous whether it reads as 'empty' at a glance, a real caveat independent of the ticks.

The one gen in the sample where axis-1 genuinely falls short of 'perfect,' independent of any collateral.
steam-porthole-ticks_ctr-401.axis4_notes: 5 button icons tinted to their guide keys

steam-porthole-ticks_ctr-402.axis1_notes: Clean engraved gear-ring with a triangle CENTER pointer (shape-distinct) plus small dash minor ticks; but the primary START/END/CENTER differentiation signal is the printed WORDS ('MIN'/'MAX'/'CENTER'), not an independent shape -- strip the text and the marks alone are weaker than fa-pod-501/502's shape-only hierarchy.

_reconciliation.ticks_shape_distinct_independent_of_text: 5/7 (fa-pod-ticks_ctr-501, fa-pod-ticks_ctr-502, steam-ticks01-401, steam-ticks01-402, steam-ticks_ctr-402) -- steam-ticks_ctr-401 is the one clean miss on distinctness, fa-pod-ticks01-502 has no ticks at all
_reconciliation.angle_register_across_all_tick_bearing_g: start clocks read 7-8 o'clock (-120 to -150deg), end clocks read 4-5 o'clock (+120 to +150deg) against the -135/+135 shipped convention -- spread is roughly +-25deg around the target, consistent across both themes, both arms, and every seed that produced a tick arc
_reconciliation.verdict: User's overrule holds on direct re-inspection: tick DRAWING quality is strong-to-excellent on 6/7, and shape-distinct on 5/7, independent of the collateral axes. The prior 0/8 adjudicated-PASS number was a full-contract AND gate (any collateral defect = FAIL) that correctly flags the clause isn't SHIP-READY as tested, but it obscured that the failures are concentrated in COLLATERAL (baked text, layout drift, icon bleed) rather than in the tick-drawing capability itself.
